issuer: the Arkansas Department of Finance and Administration, Office of Driver Services
note: Driver Services' non-commercial licence page (read 2026-10-30) gives the Class D licence, ages 21 and over, at $40.00 for 8 years (ages 18 to 21, prorated to a month past the 21st birthday); it is kept from 21, the youngest age it is issued at. The identification page gives an ID, ages 21 to 59, at $5.00 for 4 years (non-expiring from 60 if not REAL ID). No youngest age for the card was read. On 2026-10-30 the file was rewritten with the terms set by the holder's age, from the same pages. The licence: 8 years at $40.00 from 21, and from 70 a 4-year licence at $20.00 beside it (the page's 'Class D (Ages 70) *Optional', held as 70 and over, a reading). The card: 2 years at $5.00 from 5 to 14, 4 years at $5.00 from 15 (to 20 in a vertical format, from 21 to 59, and as a REAL ID from 60), and from 60 a non-expiring card at $5.00 that isn't a REAL ID. Until then the file held the 8-year licence and the 4-year card only.
